eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Eight
subtitle: Lesson 76 · Transactions and Error Handling

code:
BEGIN TRY
    SELECT 1 / 0; -- deliberate error
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    PRINT 'An error occurred: ' + ERROR_MESSAGE();
END CATCH
caption: The instant an error occurs, execution jumps STRAIGHT to CATCH.
Only meaningful INSIDE CATCH — return NULL anywhere else.
Guarantees atomicity even when something unexpected fails.

subtitle: Raising your own errors on purpose.
